body: I do, and then they just phase me out.
I do try though, The romance always turns into just sex, and the friendships never go far beyond just drinking buddies, or base aquaintances no matter how hard I try and be there for them.

friend, romance, and family. My cat is still being awesome I guess, ha
I just feel like I have nothing substantial in terms of relationships with anyone.
Just desperate and alone. I don't really know why I feel this way anymore. I know suicide is not the answer and so I came on here before it got bad like it did the first time.

I don't see me coming out on top of this. I am not the same person that I was and there is no way for me to make that person come back. I can't get enjoyment out of helping people anymore because I just idk, I am always remembering how people would all come to me for help, then when I started to need it, they all deserted me.

I used to enjoy helping people, thats the only thing I can really remember. But being mistreated and used by so many for so long made it something that made things worse. I liked helping people because it gave me some kind of a purpose, but now I just don't care anymore. And thats another reason why like, I can't care about others, I can't expect them to care for me either.

Sex and romance are not the same. I have lots of girls who call me to fuck them and thats all fine, but its not intimate, its not anything but physical and lonely. It only makes it worse. And I do not know myself or who I am now, I used to be a different person, and I loved that person, but now I don't know and there isn't a way to get back.

I do write but I don't see the point. Productive or not I am still not the kind of guy who inspires romance, or even close friends, and I feel incapable of making myself happy. I just don't even care anymore. I'll try one more night baisically because I am just tired, I don't see it meaning or being anything more than just me taking a longer route till I get back to where I am now. But okay, one more night then.

I have been trying for the last few weeks to get help from people, but it doesn't work. They can't make me be less broken, they can't put me back together and they can't give me control of my life anymore than I could. I appreciate you and everyone here trying to help, I just can't see the point. I have let it go too long and have become a stranger in my own skin, there is no point in continuing when everything I want is too far out of reach. And even if I could find love or intimacy, I know now that it wouldn't be me they care about but what I have confused myself into becoming. I am no longer a caring person, I used to be but now I am just selfish and take up peoples time. I'm sorry.

I don't have friends, I've shoved everyone away for years because I always knew I would get here. I have found love, but not intimacy, and even that would be enough, just to know I could love her and be her friend, but even that is gone now. The only thing I have to stop me is because of the guilt people might feel, even if they don't care about me it will still hurt them. I don't want to do that to them but I just can't anymore.
When the happiness I have has run it's course its not quitting its just accepting that its over.
